questions.question: The manager said that if we didn’t meet the deadline, they would have to **______** the project.
By the time she arrived home, her husband had already **______** the dinner for the family.
He told me that he **______** to visit the museum if he had more time, but he was too busy with work.
The company decided that all employees **______** to work from home for at least two days a week.
She **______** that she had never met anyone who understood her art as well as he did.
They **______** that they would need extra funding if the project faced delays.
After **______** the report, she realised that the data needed to be cross-checked with the old files.
He said that he **______** to call me if anything unexpected happened, but he didn’t.
The new policy requires staff to **______** their emails with a clear subject line and to avoid using informal language.
The scientist **______** that the experiment would take at least another week to complete, so they adjusted their schedule accordingly.
